gbifID.description: Globally unique identifier for each occurrence record.

datasetKey.description: Unique identifier linking each record to the GBIF dataset for Acrothamnus colensoi.

occurrenceID.description: Unique observation URL linking to iNaturalist or NatureWatch record.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus of the recorded plant, consistently Acrothamnus.

species.description: Species name recorded for each occurrence, always Acrothamnus colensoi.

infraspecificEpithet.description: No infraspecific epithet data recorded for any occurrence.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of each record, consistently classified at species level.

scientificName.description: Taxonomic name of the recorded species, consistently Acrothamnus colensoi (Hook.fil.) Quinn.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the observed Acrothamnus colensoi specimens.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Scientific name authorship information is unavailable for all records.

countryCode.description: Two‑letter ISO code indicating New Zealand location.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: New Zealand administrative region where each occurrence was observed.

occurrenceStatus.description: All records denote presence of the species at each observation location.

individualCount.description: Individual count of observed organisms, typically numeric, but data missing for all records.

publishingOrgKey.description: Identifier of the organization that published the occurrence record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees (east) for each occurrence record.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision is unspecified for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation data missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy data is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth values are missing for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation date and time of each record, ranging from 1977 to 2026.

year.description: Year of observation for each record.

taxonKey.description: Taxon identifier for Acrothamnus colensoi records, constant across the dataset.

speciesKey.description: Species identifier for Acrothamnus colensoi, constant across all records.

basisOfRecord.description: Human observation records indicating the source type for each occurrence entry.

institutionCode.description: Institution code identifying iNaturalist as the data source for all records.

recordNumber.description: All entries are missing; no data recorded for this field.

license.description: License type for each record, using Creative Commons identifiers.

typeStatus.description: No data recorded for this field.
